row.summary: Sets the process for citing traffic violations by autonomous vehicles: a POST-certified or state-commissioned officer must determine an offense occurred, notice goes by first-class mail to the registered owner within 20 business days with a Tennessee return address and 30 days to pay, and a second notice with another 30 days is required before added penalties. A Senate amendment defines automated driving system terms and lets state or local law enforcement adopt ADS enforcement policies consistent with the process. Enacted as Public Chapter 726.
row.summary_method: Auto-collected from the official legislature record; no figures taken from news coverage
row.takeaway: Creates a mailed-notice process for traffic citations issued to the owners of autonomous vehicles in Tennessee.
row.title: Autonomous vehicles; traffic violations
